name: agent-chat
title: Agent chat
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Workspace shell, an orchestrator thread with agents at work, and a brief for product, angle, audience, channels, palette, and call to action.

files.content:
"use client" /** * Three-pane agent conversation. Status words travel with the color so the * working state stays clear when motion is reduced. */ import * as React from "react" import { Send } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea" import { ScreenFrame, type AppShellProps, type ShellDensity } from "@/components/ui/app-shell" export type AgentChatRole = "user" | "orchestrator" | "agent" export type AgentChatMessage = { id: string role: AgentChatRole author: string body: string time?: string } export type WorkingAgentStatus = "queued" | "working" | "done" export type WorkingAgent = { id: string name: string task: string status: WorkingAgentStatus } export type BriefSwatch = "primary" | "accent" | "muted" | "chart-1" | "chart-2" | "chart-3" | "chart-4" | "chart-5" export type BriefPalette = { id: string label: string swatch: BriefSwatch } export type AgentBrief = { product: string angle: string audience: string channels: string[] palette: BriefPalette[] cta: string } export type AgentChatClassNames = { root?: string thread?: string agents?: string brief?: string composer?: string } export type AgentChatProps = { title?: string messages?: AgentChatMessage[] agents?: WorkingAgent[] brief?: AgentBrief reply?: string defaultReply?: string onReplyChange?: (value: string) => void onSend?: (text: string) => void pending?: boolean shell?: boolean shellProps?: Partial density?: ShellDensity className?: string classNames?: AgentChatClassNames } const swatchClass: Record = { primary: "bg-primary", accent: "bg-accent", muted: "bg-muted", "chart-1": "bg-chart-1", "chart-2": "bg-chart-2", "chart-3": "bg-chart-3", "chart-4": "bg-chart-4", "chart-5": "bg-chart-5", } const statusLabel: Record = { queued: "En espera", working: "Trabajando", done: "Listo", } const statusClass: Record = { queued: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground", working: "bg-accent text-accent-foreground", done: "bg-primary/10 text-primary", } export const agentChatMessages: AgentChatMessage[] = [ { id: "m1", role: "user", author: "Mara Solís", time: "09:14", body: "Necesito un encargo para presentar la linterna de campo al equipo de obra.", }, { id: "m2", role: "orchestrator", author: "Orquestador", time: "09:14", body: "Armo el encargo en tres partes: contexto del producto, ángulo y una llamada a la acción. Investigación y redacción trabajan en paralelo.", }, { id: "m3", role: "agent", author: "Investigación", time: "09:15", body: "El público pide menos ruido y un alcance corto. El canal más usado esta semana fue el correo del lunes.", }, ] export const agentChatAgents: WorkingAgent[] = [ { id: "research", name: "Investigación", task: "Audiencia y canales", status: "done" }, { id: "writer", name: "Redacción", task: "Borrador del encargo", status: "working" }, { id: "review", name: "Revisión", task: "Tono y cifras", status: "queued" }, ] export const agentChatBrief: AgentBrief = { product: "Linterna de campo", angle: "Menos ruido, más alcance", audience: "Cuadrillas pequeñas de obra", channels: ["Correo", "Sitio", "Ficha impresa"], palette: [ { id: "ink", label: "Tinta", swatch: "primary" }, { id: "paper", label: "Papel", swatch: "muted" }, { id: "signal", label: "Señal", swatch: "chart-2" }, ], cta: "Pedir una muestra", } const roleLabel: Record = { user: "Tú", orchestrator: "Coordinación", agent: "Agente", } export function AgentChat({ title = "Encargo de la linterna", messages = agentChatMessages, agents = agentChatAgents, brief = agentChatBrief, reply, defaultReply = "", onReplyChange, onSend, pending = false, shell = true, shellProps, density = "comfortable", className, classNames, }: AgentChatProps) { const replyId = React.useId() const [replyState, setReplyState] = React.useState(defaultReply) const draft = reply ?? replyState const space = density === "compact" ? "p-3" : "p-4" function setDraft(next: string) { onReplyChange?.(next) if (reply === undefined) setReplyState(next) } return (

Conversación

{title}

{agents.filter((agent) => agent.status === "working").length} en curso
{messages.length === 0 ? (

La conversación está vacía.

) : (
    {messages.map((message) => (

  1. {roleLabel[message.role]} · {message.author}

    {message.time ? {message.time} : null}

    {message.body}

    2. ))}
)}

Agentes en curso

{agents.length === 0 ? (

Nadie está trabajando.

) : (
    {agents.map((agent) => (
  • {agent.name} {agent.task} {agent.status === "working" ? ( ) : null} {statusLabel[agent.status]}
    • ))}
)}
{ event.preventDefault() if (pending || !draft.trim()) return onSend?.(draft.trim()) if (reply === undefined) setReplyState("") }} >

meta.descriptionEs: Shell, conversación con coordinación y agentes en curso, y un panel de encargo con producto, ángulo, audiencia, canales, paleta y llamada a la acción.

examples.title: Encargo de la linterna
examples.description: Tres columnas: barra, hilo y encargo.

api.name: agents
api.description: Queued, working, or done. The word is visible, not only the color.

api.name: brief
api.description: Product, angle, audience, channels, named palette swatches, and call to action.

api.name: onSend
api.description: Reply from the composer at the bottom of the thread.

api.name: shell
api.description: Default true. Set false to render only the thread and brief.

api.name: classNames
api.description: Slot classes for the thread, agent list, brief, and composer.

docs: Inspirado en patrones de Affect UI (preview público); reimplementación clean-room; no código ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. Instalar también trae @retana/app-shell.
